executive_summary: The day centered on shipping agent-operability infrastructure—Autonomous Backlog and Decisions plugins—alongside a broad set of desktop UX and plugin-runtime fixes. Agent threads drove backlog verification and in-progress work on summary hub and skill authoring. No architectural decisions were logged and no high-priority blockers remain open.

Landed the Decisions plugin (ADR logging, CLI, and decision-log skill) as companion infrastructure for recording architectural choices
Completed TASK-001 end-to-end verification confirming Autonomous Backlog persistence and workflow
Extensions UX: Browse is now the default tab in Plugins/Skills; tab overflow controls restored
Git support now activates after `git init` on existing workspaces, including status/diff before the first commit (host daemon protocol v76)
Plugin runtime reliability: interactive tools survive Connect timeouts beyond 30s; ACP plugin tools work in packaged Electron builds
Desktop polish: terminal panel load performance, right-panel resize sensitivity, sidechat file links, and workflows structured-fallback/repair settlement fixes
